reviewedFacts: The predecessor authority, review and validator are byte and SHA-256 pinned.
The frontend and backend dwp-dev commits and trees and the reviewed AUTH branch commit and tree are pinned.
The reviewed AUTH remote must equal 0a8faf2; after amendment it may equal only the reviewed commit or the single amended tip until force-with-lease completes.
All ten P1 and three P2 review findings are represented by thirteen required remediations in one bounded round.
The original twenty-one paths remain bounded and exactly six required implementation and test paths are added.
V272 may be hardened in place only because it has not entered backend dwp-dev or any deployment; V273 authoring is forbidden.

The required scenarios cover direct-DB forgery, DB-time lease races, durable drain, fresh replay proof, pre-body TLS denial, external lease rotation, tenant pagination, revocation tombstones, tenant time zones, poison isolation, replay cleanup and signed Auth readiness.
The implementation remains default-off and no activation, enrollment, credentials, live network, production, other-module, UI or central integration authority is granted.
Only the named compile and Auth selectors may be run; a broad repository rerun is prohibited.
The AUTH commit may be amended and force-pushed only after targeted verification and with force-with-lease.

residualSourceFindings.finding: The reviewed default-off AUTH implementation is not safe to activate until all required seal remediations pass.
Operational isolation, cleanup and omitted runtime evidence remain incomplete.

nonClaims: This review does not claim that any source finding is fixed.
